author: bono
context: Mechanism-trust-check upstream of the Facet-7 end-to-end pod-state fix RCA (§S-172 / §S-146). The fix (I2 launch_args + I3 agent->heart bridge) depends on shared infrastructure: the SSE broadcast delivery, the agent WS GameStateUpdate transport, the heart binary deploy to .23, and the heart_v2_real_launch flag config_push. Per doctrine ALL 5 questions must answer YES; any FAIL gives that surface its own RCA first.

q1_atomic_primitives.evidence: SSE = tokio broadcast::Sender, send never panics on no-subscribers (`let _ = tx.send()`), Lagged -> full-snapshot resync (heart_v2.rs:958-992 pods_state_stream, no silent skip). active_games + state.heart are RwLock-guarded; transition mutators (launch_loading/promote_to_running/fail_launch/end, heart_v2.rs:335-470) are atomic under the heart write lock. Flag write is atomic per-row with a version column (flags.rs:184-245).
q1_atomic_primitives.caveat: The I3 bridge MUST drop the active_games write lock (game_launcher_state.rs:34) BEFORE taking state.heart.write() and MUST NOT hold either across `.await` (CLAUDE.md never-hold-lock-across-await). Enforced by code review + MAOR, not by the primitive itself.

q2_ttl_bounded_sentinels.evidence: Real-launch promotion is bounded: dispatch-poll grants green-light ONLY on verified_running within a bounded poll (confirm-before-bill); the 15s reconcile_heart_green_light_once (reconcile_green_light heart_v2.rs:422) is the TTL backstop for missed promotions; SSE keep-alive 15s. Flag read is at request-time (no stale sentinel).
q2_ttl_bounded_sentinels.caveat: I3 must NOT introduce an un-TTL'd sentinel: a `crashed` PodState must be terminal/transient and cleared idempotently by the next launch on that pod (no permanent stuck state — cf. GameTracker-stuck-in-Launching class).

q3_behavioral_verify.evidence: Deploy verifies build_id + 4-endpoint smoke (behavioral, not echo). Probe 2026-06-02: .23:8080/api/v1/health build_id=21531f31, /heart/pods HTTP 200. Fix verification (Layer B) is behavioral: real launch -> agent GameStateUpdate -> heart PodState -> SSE -> panel renders + crash preserves green_light + exit frees pod + ₹ reconciled. No echo-string proxies.

q4_single_target_dry_run.evidence: Pod-8 canary is the single-target dry-run for the real-pod path. Heart deploy targets the single .23 heart. Flag flip is single-target (.23). Mock-heart + CI (heart_v2.rs unit tests, admin-proxy session-e2e) provide a no-real-pod dry-run for the wire shape.

q5_guards_written_contracts.evidence: Agent->heart input contract is the typed GameLaunchInfo struct (serde parser, not regex). heart_routes are unauthenticated LAN-internal with the admin-proxy as the written auth boundary (RACECONTROL_HEART_URL + /heart/... contract). Deploy guard = deploy-server.sh SWAPLOG + manifest.
q5_guards_written_contracts.gap: admin-proxy m5-handlers.ts:17 defaults RACECONTROL_HEART_URL to mock-heart :8090 — if unset in prod it SILENTLY serves mock state with no error (the V1-shaped silent-failure class this check exists to catch). Agent GameStateUpdate WS push is fire-and-forget (not acked) — a dropped WS loses a state update.
mitigations_required: I1: probe-confirm .23 admin-proxy RACECONTROL_HEART_URL=:8080 before I5.
I4: change m5-handlers.ts default to fail-closed (throw if unset in prod) so it can never silently serve mock.
I3: make the bridge idempotent and rely on the 15s reconciler as the backstop for dropped GameStateUpdate (do not assume every push arrives).

rationale: Q1-Q4 YES. Q5 PARTIAL is a config/env silent-mock-fallback with a clear in-scope mitigation (I4 fail-closed + I1 probe-confirm) and a typed (not regex) data contract — it does not warrant a separate §S-146 RCA for the delivery surface; it is folded into the main fix RCA as mandatory mitigations gating I5. The delivery mechanism (deploy-server.sh, flag config_push, SSE broadcast) is V2-clean and atomic — this fix is NOT shipping via a V1-shaped delivery mechanism (the PR #66 anti-pattern).
